cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to convey my keen interest in the Content Writer position at Unknown. I am particularly drawn to this opportunity to craft compelling, on-brand copy for your social media and campaign initiatives. My background as a Junior Digital Marketer, focused on content creation, SEO, and web management, aligns perfectly with the requirements outlined in your job posting.

In my current role at Episto, I am responsible for the full lifecycle of keyword-targeted blog content, from initial research to final publication, significantly improving organic visibility for client websites. This involves not only writing but also ensuring the content resonates with target audiences and supports specific brand objectives. I also build and maintain client websites in WordPress, managing content uploads and page updates, which has provided me with a robust understanding of how content integrates within a broader digital strategy.

Beyond client work, my personal project, mirook.com, demonstrates a proactive approach to content and brand development. I designed and built this multi-page WordPress site, implemented comprehensive on-page SEO, and integrated social media (Instagram/Facebook). Crucially, I applied structured data and entity optimization, alongside technical SEO/GEO audits, to enhance content discoverability across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has equipped me with a deep understanding of how to craft stories that engage and truly strengthen a brand's online presence.

I am comfortable with content management, social media coordination, and leveraging performance data to inform decisions. My technical foundation, combined with a quick adaptability to new tools, enables me to collaborate effectively with strategy and design teams. I am enthusiastic about contributing my skills to an innovative team and helping Unknown tell impactful stories.

Thank you for reviewing my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my experience can benefit your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
